Attached: 4 images

Busy all day, and nothing out there answered you.

Preparing and acting look the same from the outside. Same desk, same focus, same tired feeling in the evening. The difference is the feedback: preparation answers you from inside your own head, action brings back a yes, a no, a number.

Preparation wins so often because it is effort without risk. While the offer sits in the drawer, nobody has rejected it.
